_doc: Defaults for any gGest database. Override per database with ggest.json next to data.sqlite (see config.example.json).
_services: product lines that are really service work count as services (no cost): items in these groups or codes, or lines without cost and stock movement whose description matches service_description_like (SQL LIKE on lower case; '_' stands for accented letters)
_regions: customer regions (view customer_regions): first rule whose 4-digit postcode range matches; for customers without a postcode, first rule whose address text matches locality_like (SQL LIKE on ' lower-case text '). Defaults: Portugal by postcode. unknown_area: area label when nothing finer is known
_areas: finer areas inside regions, in priority order: a postcode range match first, then address words (customers without a postcode or with one in the area's region), then postal_names (the locality name in gGest's postcode table codpostal); otherwise the codpostal locality name itself
